title: HardwareTiers
description: Data file content/hardware/tiers.json: hardware tiers and their thresholds. Tiers are listed from lowest to highest; the highest tier whose requirements are all met applies. Below the first tier the PC is not supported.

description.description: Short English description of what runs on this tier.

requires_any.description: The tier applies if at least one of these requirement sets is fully met.

Requirement.description: All given limits must be met. Omitted limits are not checked.

min_largest_gpu_vram_mib.description: VRAM of the largest NVIDIA GPU in MiB as reported by nvidia-smi. Cards report slightly less than their nominal size, so thresholds carry a tolerance.

min_second_largest_gpu_vram_mib.description: VRAM of the second-largest NVIDIA GPU in MiB (0 if there is only one). Use it for multi-GPU tiers so that a small second card does not count.

LearnByDay.description: B2652 (A1568): whether this tier offers the switch 'learn by day as well'. By default new things are learned in the computing night on every PC (B2650); the switch is offered only where the PC is strong enough. Omitted: not offered.

offered.description: The tier offers the switch at all.

max_language_seconds_per_job.description: If set: offered only when the measurement run (B7 R6) found the language model at most this many seconds per job; without a measurement it is not offered. Null: no measured condition.
